_readme: The brief for every article cover. build_covers.py reads alt_ar and alt_en from here; subject is the line the master render in covers-src/ was generated from, kept so a cover can be regenerated without reverse-engineering it from the picture. Generate with: subject + ' ' + _style.
_style: Modern 3D render in a soft matte clay style. One hero subject, centred in frame, resting on a seamless warm cream floor with a soft contact shadow. Background is warm cream (#F7F2EC) carrying a very faint, large-scale Islamic geometric star pattern, barely visible. Palette: mint teal (#00D4AA to #2BB39A), deep navy (#1E3A5F), terracotta (#D98B6F) and off-white. Soft diffused studio lighting, gentle rim light, shallow depth of field, subtle glow accents. Generous empty cream space to the left and right of the subject. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no human faces. Clean editorial medical illustration, 16:9.
